commits.message:
Effected measures what its child draws; onColors and wheel read it (rich-effects-cbgp.071)

An effect is now handed what the element draws in the frame (`Drawn`: the
ink/ground pairs of its word cells, its own colours and fills, the depth and
theme), measured in Effected's render off the same per-segment reading its
cells are drawn from. `onColors(loop, colors?)` settles its shares against
that measurement, memoized per set of colours drawn; `wheel(curve, z)` reads
its colours and fills from it. `drawnOf` exposes the same measurement.

Strip and FlexStrip stamp every join they draw with the `JOIN` owner, so a
seam is left out of the words kept legible without the caller's help.

The effects-feel demo's copy of that measurement (drawnSubject's pairs and
colours, subjectUnder, fills, cellsOf, shown, seamed) is gone; its frames are
byte-identical across 4 themes x 3 depths x 4 loops x 10 instants.

`shares` leaves the barrel: no caller needs it now.
Lone ESC alone holds on the timer: a sequence split after its introducer waits for its rest (rich-host-input-0c4f)
Held ESC: one rule in feed, the sink hears Escape after the buffer settles, and an ESC[/ESC O introducer that opens nothing is replayed as keys (rich-host-input-0c4f)

A held lone ESC is Escape unless the next chunk opens a CSI/SS3 sequence (rich-host-input-0c4f)

A busy worker can queue the next key ahead of the 0ms hold timer, so
Escape then G read as Alt+G. Only [ or O continues a split introducer;
any other next chunk emits the held ESC first. Drops the toPass retry in
e2e/rich-explore.spec.ts that worked around it.

The parser holds a lone ESC for one setTimeout(0); under load the test's

The test now asserts focus left the card and retries G (move-last).
